titulo.alumno: Distinguished · Persuasion and rhetorical devices: Listening comprehension

intro: T5 · Proficient · Interpret implicit meaning, tone and sociocultural references; analyse abstract texts, cultural reviews and documentary sources. Topic: Persuasion and rhetorical devices. Focus: Listening comprehension (optional).

frases.alumno: Ordering arguments from the weakest to the strongest builds persuasive force.

texto: Listening comprehension of masterly persuasive speeches and high-level debates: train yourself to analyse the rhetorical cadence, the emphatic pauses and the expository order (recognising the rival's objection followed by the core argument). When you hear «เป้าหมายไม่ใช่เพียงเอาชนะ แต่คือโน้มน้าวอย่างมีเหตุผล», distinguish the deliberative aim of the speaker from purely combative rhetoric.

palabras: ข้อคัดค้าน

pregunta.texto: Reading comprehension: According to the text, which idea does the sentence «ผู้พูดควรระบุผลประโยชน์ที่ผู้ฟังจะได้รับเพื่อสร้างแรงจูงใจในการคล้อยตามข้อเสนอ» express?

opciones.texto: Highlighting the advantages for the audience encourages them to accept the proposal.
opciones.explicacion: Correct: this option translates and accurately interprets the sentence «ผู้พูดควรระบุผลประโยชน์ที่ผู้ฟังจะได้รับเพื่อสร้างแรงจูงใจในการคล้อยตามข้อเสนอ» from the text.

opciones.texto: Rhetorical questions prompt the listener to reflect on their own certainties.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this is another complementary statement from the passage, not the meaning of the sentence in question.

opciones.texto: Ordering arguments from the weakest to the strongest builds persuasive force.
opciones.explicacion: Incorrect: this option corresponds to another sentence in the reading passage.

pregunta.texto: Read the sentence and choose its meaning.
